cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

mechanism: A uses supervisory control of who may ask questions to preserve a performance of expertise after a practical mistake is exposed.
confusable: Merely sounding technical is not enough: A must assume authority over the real expert and convert scrutiny into supervised work.
comparison: The boiler scene redirects a remote engineer inquiry; the violin scene reframes visible breakage as quality control before an audition.
seedUse: The D18-a timer mistake and engineer exchange already join S01 control of questioning with fake expertise.
